item.title: Version 2.5.0
item.description:
## 2.5.0 (2026-11-20)
### New Features
* show how long each result took in the main window, with a setting to hide it
### Improvements
* more even corners and spacing in the main window * the result bubble opens right away and shows a placeholder while the result loads * the selection bubble, main window, Translate File window and live captions stand out on any app theme or video
